item.title: Cost of Living in Oakleigh South Melbourne
item.description:
Everyone asks how expensive is Oakleigh South. The real answer depends on your lifestyle. Here is the data.

Read our full Oakleigh South suburb guide for the bigger picture.

Is Oakleigh South Expensive?

Oakleigh South sits somewhere in the middle of Melbourne’s cost spectrum. It’s not cheap, but it’s not going to break the bank either — assuming you’re realistic about expectations.

The cost of living here reflects what the suburb offers. Location, community, access to amenities — you get what you pay for, and in Oakleigh South, you’re generally getting good value for the price point.
